title: DCST: Dynamic Causal Spatiotemporal Digital Twins for Individualized Treatment-Response Prediction in Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma
description: Source code, experimental notebook (Google Colab–ready), figures, and summary results for DCST — a systems-level architecture combining multi-scale residual Heterogeneous Graph Transformer, hierarchical Bayesian digital twin, uncertainty-aware causal intervention planner, and adaptive DP-FedAvg for PDAC treatment-response prediction. Evaluated under a leakage-free protocol on a signal-controlled in-silico cohort (N=800) and real TCGA-PAAD clinical data (N=92).
